query:
SELECT to_char(a.taken_at AT TIME ZONE $1, 'YYYY-MM') AS "month!",
                  count(*) AS "count!"
           FROM assets a
           WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL
             AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM asset_babies ab WHERE ab.asset_id = a.id AND ab.baby_id = $2))
           GROUP BY 1
           ORDER BY 1 DESC
